info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Insurance Claims Claims Deny-v4-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Denial Management API enables users to efficiently manage and remove denied insurance claims from the system. This operation is crucial for maintaining accurate records and streamlining the claims processing workflow. Targeted towards insurance providers and claims administrators, the API facilitates the cleanup of accounts by allowing the deletion of claims that have been denied. Typical use cases include routine audits and data remediation efforts to ensure compliance and operational efficiency.

delete.description: This operation allows you to deny an existing claim based on the provided criteria. Ensure that all required parameters are set correctly before executing the request.

200.description: Request successfully completed; the claim has been denied.
